<style id="ax-s148b">
/* s148b: the brief body in the Lithium Glance mockup's type and tiles (Jonathan 2026-10-18; claude/pending/SITE_BODY_GLANCE.md,
   Decided A to D, work plan item 1). Site-wide, no text changes. One raised flat card for every tile, no tint, no inset
   shadow, no heading glow; mockup type scale; labels and table headers in sentence case; onset timeline cards that fit
   their text (placement by the ax-s148b-on script). */
:root,[data-theme="dark"]{--sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",Inter,Roboto,system-ui,sans-serif;--serif:var(--sans)}

/* every rule leads with html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) so it outranks the dark-theme layer's rules in both themes */
/* the card surface: raised in sculpted mode, the flat sheet color in flat mode (the value .tw already takes there) */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief{--g-card:var(--raised)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .axm-flat .brief,html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.axm-flat{--g-card:#FBFBFB}
html[data-theme="dark"] body .axm-flat .brief,html[data-theme="dark"] body .brief.axm-flat{--g-card:#161616}

/* header: title, topic line (Decided A: the live topic list, restyled), question */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief > h4{font:800 48px/54px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.9px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief > h4::after{line-height:1.2;vertical-align:14px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .sub{font-size:19px;line-height:26px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 30px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .sub .subq{display:block;max-width:720px;margin-top:18px;font:700 23px/30px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.2px;font-style:normal;color:var(--ink)}

/* step headings: mockup scale, badge 36 px; the glow behind them is removed (Decided B) */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief h5.tsec{font:700 30px/36px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.5px;margin:64px 0 18px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp h5.sp-h{gap:14px;margin:64px 0 18px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-n{min-width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;font:700 17px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:0}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp h5.sp-h::before{content:none}

/* tiles (Decided B): one raised flat card, radius 24, no gradient, tint or inset shadow */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette,.mcq,.scriptcard,.sp-script,.sp-row,.sp-ladder,.sp-inst,.sp-pause,details.sp-sys,figure.lcp,figure.lcw,figure.sw,figure.sp-on,ol.sp-trk){
  background:var(--g-card);background-image:none;box-shadow:var(--e2),0 0 0 1px var(--hair);border-radius:24px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette){padding:20px 24px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-pause{border-left:0;padding:16px 24px;font-size:16px;line-height:24px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on ol.sp-trk{background:none;box-shadow:none}
@media (min-width:641px){
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw:not(.scriptcard .tw){background:var(--g-card);background-image:none;box-shadow:var(--e2),0 0 0 1px var(--hair);border-radius:24px;padding:8px 10px 4px}
}

/* tile text and labels: 16 px body; labels 14 px weight 650, sentence case (colors kept; Bottom line green) */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette) :is(p,li,dd,dt){font-size:16px;line-height:24px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette) .lbl{font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;margin-bottom:8px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .dp .lbl{color:var(--confirm)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-script .sk{font-size:15px;line-height:24px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--muted)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-script .sv p{font-size:16px;line-height:23px}

/* other labels in sentence case: urgent-risk names, ladder tags, the workup kicker, NBME and caption sub-labels,
   unclassed sub-headings; the practice header takes the step heading scale */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-src{font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-row > b.sp-f,html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-commit{font-size:16px;line-height:23px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-when > b{font:650 14px/20px var(--sans);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-when span{font-size:15px;line-height:21px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-ladder b.sp-f{font-size:17px;line-height:24px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .kick{font-size:15px;line-height:20px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .nbh{font-size:13px;line-height:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief caption .cap-sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief > h5:not([class]){font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief h5.authored-hdr{font:700 30px/36px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.5px;text-transform:none;color:var(--ink)}

/* tables: headers 13 px sentence case; cells 16/23 weight 450, first column 700 */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief table th{font-size:13px;line-height:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--muted)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw td{font-size:16px;line-height:23px;font-weight:450}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw td:first-child{font-weight:700}

/* a table cell's source line (td .ex) on a study-mode mask band: ink-2 so it holds 4.5:1 (was 3.8 on live, septic-hip) */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body.study .brief td .ex{color:var(--ink-2)}

/* hover cards: 15/21 weight 500 text, 13 px weight 650 grey label */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-card,html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-pop-b{font-size:15px;line-height:21px;font-weight:500}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-card{max-width:360px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:20px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-pop-b{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--g-card);box-shadow:var(--e2),0 0 0 1px var(--hair)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.sp-pop-b,.sp-card) .sp-ct{font:650 13px/18px var(--sans);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 4px}

/* onset timeline (Decided D): cards wrap to fit their text; ax-s148b-on places them in tiers with no overlap */
@media (min-width:641px){
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li > div{width:max-content;max-width:var(--cmw,280px);white-space:normal}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-on-ev > li > div > *{white-space:normal}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-on-f.sp-on-js .sp-on-ev > li > div{left:var(--cx);bottom:var(--cb);transform:none}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-on-f.sp-on-js .sp-on-ev > li::before{height:var(--lh)}
}
/* where the cards cannot fit at a width, the figure takes the phone list layout */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-f{height:auto}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-ax{position:relative;height:20px;margin:0 0 2px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list :is(.sp-on-ax,.sp-on-tk)::before{display:none}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-tk{top:0;bottom:auto;font-size:12px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-ev > li{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;width:auto;height:auto;padding:9px 0 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-ev > li::before{left:0;right:0;bottom:11px;width:auto;height:2px;background:var(--ink);opacity:.22}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-ev > li::after{bottom:5px;left:calc(var(--x) * 1% - 7px)}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp figure.sp-on.sp-on-list .sp-on-ev > li > div{position:static;transform:none;width:auto;max-width:none;padding:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;white-space:normal}

/* phone (the mockup has no phone design): title 32, question 19, step heading 24, tiles radius 18, body 16 */
@media (max-width:640px){
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief > h4{font-size:32px;line-height:38px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief > h4::after{vertical-align:7px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .sub{font-size:16px;line-height:22px;margin-bottom:24px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .sub .subq{font-size:19px;line-height:25px;margin-top:12px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief h5.tsec{font-size:24px;line-height:30px;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin:44px 0 14px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp h5.sp-h{gap:12px;margin:44px 0 14px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-n{min-width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;font-size:15px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief h5.authored-hdr{font-size:24px;line-height:30px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette,.mcq,.scriptcard,.sp-script,.sp-row,.sp-ladder,.sp-inst,.sp-pause,details.sp-sys,figure.lcp,figure.lcw,figure.sw,figure.sp-on,ol.sp-trk,.sp-pop-b){border-radius:18px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body :is(.brief.sp,.brief) :is(.dp,.pearls,.danger,.rule,.crit,.vignette){padding:16px 18px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief.sp .sp-pause{padding:14px 18px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw table:not(.cluet):not(.script) > tbody:not(.grp) > tr,html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw table.cluet tbody,html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw tbody.grp{background:var(--g-card);background-image:none;box-shadow:var(--e2),0 0 0 1px var(--hair);border-radius:18px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw tbody td{font-size:16px;line-height:23px}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw tbody td:not(:first-child)::before{font-size:13px;line-height:18px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
  html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .brief .tw table.script tbody td:first-child{font-size:13px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
}

/* a brief inside a drawer (520 px panel) takes the phone heading scale */
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief > h4{font-size:32px;line-height:38px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief > h4::after{vertical-align:7px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief .sub{font-size:16px;line-height:22px;margin-bottom:24px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief .sub .subq{font-size:19px;line-height:25px;margin-top:12px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief :is(h5.tsec,h5.authored-hdr){font-size:24px;line-height:30px;letter-spacing:-.3px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief :is(h5.tsec,h5.sp-h){margin:44px 0 14px}
html:is([data-theme],:not([data-theme])) body .sp-drawer .brief.sp .sp-n{min-width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;font-size:15px}
</style>
<script id="ax-s148b-on">
/* s148b: onset timeline placement (Jonathan 2026-10-18, "the timeline boxes should adapt to fit all text within it";
   claude/pending/SITE_BODY_GLANCE.md, Decided D). After layout and on every resize: walk the events left to right and put
   each card on the lowest tier where it overlaps no card (8 px gap), its leader line crosses no card below it, and it
   covers no leader line from above; each tier sits on the tallest card below it and the chart height follows. If the
   cards cannot fit at a width, the figure takes the phone list layout. Phone and study mode keep their list layouts. */
(function(){
  var GAP = 8, BASE = 48, AXIS = 31, MAXT = 5, PAD = 4, LEAD = 4, WIDTHS = [280, 240, 210, 180];
  var phone = window.matchMedia('(max-width:640px)');
  function reset(f){
    var fig = f.closest('figure.sp-on');
    if(fig) fig.classList.remove('sp-on-list');
    f.classList.remove('sp-on-js'); f.style.height = ''; f.style.removeProperty('--cmw');
    f.querySelectorAll('.sp-on-ev > li').forEach(function(li){
      ['--cx', '--cb', '--lh'].forEach(function(k){ li.style.removeProperty(k); });
    });
  }
  // a search over tiers and left edges, events taken left to right, nearest the preferred spot first: a card overlaps no
  // card on its tier (8 px gap); its own leader line stays inside it, 12 px in from each side; its leader crosses no card
  // below it and it covers no leader line from a card above (events at the same time share one line); null if none fits
  function layout(items, W){
    var placed = [], nodes = 0;
    items.forEach(function(it){ it.pref = it.al === 'r' ? it.x - it.w : it.al === 'c' ? it.x - it.w / 2 : it.x - 14; });
    function same(a, b){ return Math.abs(a.x - b.x) < 2; }
    function ok(it, t, L){
      var R = L + it.w;
      return placed.every(function(o){
        if(o.t === t) return R + GAP <= o.L || o.R + GAP <= L;
        if(same(o, it)) return true;
        if(o.t < t) return it.x < o.L - LEAD || it.x > o.R + LEAD;
        return o.x < L - LEAD || o.x > R + LEAD;
      });
    }
    function go(i){
      if(i === items.length) return true;
      if(++nodes > 20000) return false;
      var it = items[i];
      if(!it.w || it.w > W) return false;
      var lo = Math.max(0, it.x - it.w + 12), hi = Math.min(W - it.w, it.x - 12);
      if(lo > hi) return false;
      var cand = [it.pref, lo, hi];
      placed.forEach(function(o){ cand.push(o.L - GAP - it.w, o.R + GAP, o.x - LEAD - it.w, o.x + LEAD + 0.5); });
      items.slice(i + 1).forEach(function(o){ cand.push(o.x - LEAD - 0.5 - it.w); });   // room for later leader lines
      cand = cand.map(function(L){ return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, L)); })
        .sort(function(a, b){ return Math.abs(a - it.pref) - Math.abs(b - it.pref); })
        .filter(function(L, k, A){ return A.indexOf(L) === k; });
      for(var t = 0; t < MAXT; t++){
        for(var c = 0; c < cand.length; c++){
          if(!ok(it, t, cand[c])) continue;
          it.t = t; it.L = cand[c]; it.R = cand[c] + it.w; placed.push(it);
          if(go(i + 1)) return true;
          placed.pop();
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    if(!go(0)) return null;
    var tiers = [];
    items.forEach(function(o){ (tiers[o.t] = tiers[o.t] || []).push(o); });
    return tiers;
  }
  function place(f){
    var W = f.clientWidth;
    if(!W) return;                 // not laid out (hidden, or mid-capture): keep the last placement
    reset(f);
    f._w = W;
    if(phone.matches || document.body.classList.contains('study')) return;
    var fig = f.closest('figure.sp-on'), tiers = null, items = [];
    for(var m = 0; !tiers && m < WIDTHS.length; m++){   // narrower cards, more lines, before giving up the chart
      f.style.setProperty('--cmw', WIDTHS[m] + 'px');
      items = [].map.call(f.querySelectorAll('.sp-on-ev > li'), function(li){
        var d = li.firstElementChild;
        return {li: li, w: d ? d.offsetWidth : 0, h: d ? d.offsetHeight : 0,
                x: (parseFloat(li.style.getPropertyValue('--x')) || 0) / 100 * W,
                al: li.classList.contains('a-r') ? 'r' : li.classList.contains('a-c') ? 'c' : 'l'};
      }).sort(function(a, b){ return a.x - b.x; });
      tiers = layout(items, W);
    }
    if(!tiers){ f.style.removeProperty('--cmw'); if(fig) fig.classList.add('sp-on-list'); return; }
    var bottom = [], b = BASE;
    for(var k = 0; k < tiers.length; k++){
      tiers[k] = tiers[k] || [];
      bottom[k] = b;
      b += Math.max.apply(null, tiers[k].map(function(o){ return o.h; }).concat([0])) + GAP;
    }
    items.forEach(function(o){
      var cb = bottom[o.t];
      o.li.style.setProperty('--cx', (o.L - o.x) + 'px');
      o.li.style.setProperty('--cb', cb + 'px');
      o.li.style.setProperty('--lh', (cb - AXIS + 6) + 'px');
    });
    f.classList.add('sp-on-js');
    f.style.height = (b - GAP + PAD) + 'px';
  }
  function all(root){ (root || document).querySelectorAll('.sp-on-f').forEach(place); }
  var ro = window.ResizeObserver ? new ResizeObserver(function(es){
    es.forEach(function(e){ var f = e.target; if(f.clientWidth && f.clientWidth !== f._w) place(f); });
  }) : null;
  function watch(root){ (root || document).querySelectorAll('.sp-on-f').forEach(function(f){ if(ro && !f._ro){ f._ro = 1; ro.observe(f); } }); }
  function start(){
    all(); watch();
    if(document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ all(); });
    var study = document.body.classList.contains('study');
    new MutationObserver(function(){     // study mode on or off (a class on body only)
      var s = document.body.classList.contains('study');
      if(s !== study){ study = s; all(); }
    }).observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class']});
    new MutationObserver(function(ms){   // a drawer that brings a brief in
      ms.forEach(function(m){
        m.addedNodes.forEach(function(n){
          if(n.nodeType === 1 && (n.matches('.sp-on-f') || n.querySelector('.sp-on-f'))){ var r = n.parentNode || n; watch(r); all(r); }
        });
      });
    }).observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
  }
  window.axOnset = all;
  if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();
})();
</script>
</body>
edits.note: s148b: brief body restyle to the Lithium Glance mockup and onset timeline placement (site layer)
